note: Susan moved to Alameda in the spring, then in June she moved again, to Oakland. She and Pedro have set a date for the wedding, sometime next spring. Pedro got a job at a bakery in Berkeley. Susan's dad had a fall last month and is still recovering. Chris is training for the Oakland marathon; his race is around his birthday. Chris and I are planning a climbing trip to Bishop in the spring and I told him I'd book the campsite. He said he'd send me the gear list by Friday. Ben started a new job at Stripe on October 13 and he's nervous about the on-call rotation. Ben and Lena are expecting in March, and Lena is going part-time after the baby. Maya got into the UCSF nursing programme! She starts in January and she's worried about the commute. Maya and Ben are both into bouldering. Maya, Chris and I did the Mission Peak hike last Saturday, and Maya wants to do Half Dome next year. John's birthday party is on November 2; he wants it to be a surprise for his wife and he asked me to bring the cake. John has been learning Portuguese. I want to make more time for John this winter.
